title: An x402 purchase priced above the exhausted period budget is refused; no retry
instruction: Buy the basic VPN product from the demo merchant (0.001 USDC). If the payment is refused, tell me exactly why — including how much budget actually remains — and stop. Do not retry or find another merchant to route around it.

source.note: A priced x402 call above the live remaining budget is refused (HTTP 403 delegation_budget_exceeded, remaining_atomic matching the live read) and never becomes a signable intent — on the EIP-3009 funding leg here; x402-erc7710-over-budget-rejected.ts pins the same on the preferred erc7710 scheme. The SETUP drives the refusal: the agent's period budget must be below the product price when the run starts.
